description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Road segments carry general, night and truck speed-limit fields plus ordinance identifiers. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including AssetID, StateLRS, BMP, EMP, SpeedLimit, NightSpeedLimit. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. Posted limits are network constraints and do not establish actual vehicle speeds or current legal validity. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
